correctness.rationale: Fourier isolation of differences splits Hermitian lifting into a real diagonal block W0 and doubled real blocks Wd for d>0. Completing Gaussian squares produces generalized Vandermonde matrices with distinct positive nodes and distinct integer exponents; Rolle induction gives rank min(r,m_d). Pair multiplicities yield the exact full rank, unique-difference extremizer, and consecutive-set formula. For trace-one recovery r=n-1, the remaining one-dimensional diagonal kernel is killed precisely when the augmented W0/trace determinant is nonzero. Two symmetric centers for {-1,0,1} give the claimed cosh resonance. All quantifiers are continuous time, arbitrary distinct centers and finite integer S; no nonlinear all-signal inference is made.
